Graph search: SECTION_GRAPH_ADJACENCY CSR/CSC edges (reusing intpack), bounded-BFS seeded from exact-cosine top-k feeding the exact rerank; drop chunk_overlap text by reconstructing neighbor context from NEXT_CHUNK edges; 9th CLI subcommand.

Real-time edit: SECTION_EDIT_JOURNAL append-only deltas overlaid in memory at open (frozen bytes immutable) + deterministic compact() that re-runs ZDICT, re-quantizes, drops dead chunks, rebuilds indexes to the smallest preset; reproducibility preserved (compact output is byte-identical for the same live set).

Byte-level subword tokenizer (SECTION_TOKENIZER_MODEL, frozen vocab, byte_fallback + reversible markup) closing the CJK/Thai BM25 gap and serving as a token-id text codec; sovereign static embedder (model2vec/POTION) for offline re-embed.

v2 evaluation: prototype content_hash as a BLAKE3 Merkle root (the one field whose MEANING changes) behind a NEST_FORMAT_VERSION=2 gate with v1 readers retained, justified only by measured demand for partial/single-chunk citation verification and corpus-level subtree dedup; SECTION_MERKLE_INDEX (chunk-group parent CVs) and SECTION_EVAL_RESULTS (self-certified nDCG/recall per preset) ship additively first.

risks: Sub-int8 quantization silently breaks the 'returned score is real cosine' contract because score_subset reranks against the SAME lossy stored dtype - MUST land the SECTION_EMBEDDINGS_FP rerank-source (Phase 0) before shipping any int4/RaBitQ/PQ preset, or the headline guarantee becomes a half-truth.

materialize.rs expands every dtype to an n*dim*4 f32 buffer whenever HNSW is attached, so a 4-bit codec halves disk but keeps a dense f32 copy in RAM - the ANN distance path must score packed blocks (or keep f16) or the compression win is paid back in memory on exactly the tiny/hybrid presets that need it.

Determinism is the make-or-break constraint: every seeded/iterative quantizer (FWHT rotation, PQ/NF4 k-means, RaBitQ rotation, FastCDC mask, ZDICT, GPTQ/AutoRound calibration) must be a pure, seeded, fixed-iteration, stable-tie-break function or 'same chunks + same model fingerprint => byte-identical file' breaks; do NOT adopt calibration that depends on a calibration corpus, and verify byte-identical output across two builds + across SIMD backends per codec.

Float horizontal-sum reduction is non-associative so f32/f16/widened-i8 scores are only ~1e-4 cross-CPU - integer-domain int8/int4 dot (VNNI/dotprod) is preferred precisely because it restores true bit-determinism on the quantized path; any new SIMD reduction must preserve identical NaN/rounding behavior or the cross-arch parity tests correctly fail.

Codec/section ordering and dedup ordering are load-bearing: dedup and CDC MUST run on decompressed bytes with compression applied per unique block AFTER, or the dedup ratio collapses to near-zero; encode this as a code-level invariant + regression test, not a comment.

Scope/hygiene creep on a solo, minimal-budget, by-hand codebase: each codec/kernel/section must be its own <=300-line (333 hard) single-responsibility module returning typed thiserror (never panic, including on malformed/truncated mmap bytes); split pack/unpack from kernels and table-cores between encode/decode, and do the SIMD functable refactor BEFORE multiplying dtypes.

License contamination: clean-room reimplement from format descriptions/papers - TurboPFor (GPL), VectorChord/sqlite-vector (AGPL/Elastic), Neo4j/GDS/memgraph/FalkorDB/blazegraph (GPL/BSL/SSPL), nightly portable_simd/packed_simd ports - and avoid LMDB/RocksDB/serde-bincode persistence and any socket/online dependency that violates single-file/offline/no-panic/stable-edition-2024 constraints.

plans.framing: SEARCH-AND-CAPABILITY-FIRST. The moat is unified retrieval over one content-addressed mmap file: ONE engine that does exact vector, ANN (hnsw + sub-byte rabitq/pq candidate codes), full-text/BM25, graph traversal, and fast image similarity, all reranked by mandatory exact cosine, plus real-time edit, over the same .nest container. Compression is in service of retrieval, never the reverse: every codec must either (a) be scored/searched in place off mmap without breaking the hot path, or (b) live strictly on cold metadata/index sections. Grounded against the actual tree: nest already half-implements the winning two-stage pattern (lossy candidate gen + exact-cosine rerank in search.rs::score_subset; int8 already carries a scale_kind discriminator in encoding/int8.rs; reserved encoding ids 4-255 and section ids 0x09+; content_hash over decoded canonical six; mmap+SIMD dispatch). The plan turns that half into a full unified engine.
plans.thesis: nest wins not by being the smallest archive but by being the only single-file, sovereign, deterministic container where the SAME bytes you compressed are the bytes you search, cite, and verify - across every modality - with a real cosine score guaranteed at the end. Three structural facts make this winnable today: (1) the embeddings section is the dominant byte cost AND the one section banned from zstd, so the only lever is better in-place quantization (int8 -> RaBitQ 1-bit / PQ / int4), and nest's already-mandatory exact-cosine rerank makes aggressive lossy candidate codes recall-safe by construction; (2) every cold section (chunk_ids stored as 71-byte 'sha256:<hex>' strings, spans as raw u64 + a repeated source_uri per chunk, HNSW neighbor ids as raw u32, BM25 postings as raw u32 pairs) carries structural redundancy that delta+bitpack/FST/dedup remove BELOW generic zstd while staying searchable in place; (3) content-addressing already gives free corpus-level dedup-before-zstd, the biggest unrealized lever for whole-repo/whole-database ingestion. The honest hard constraint discovered in code: score_subset reranks against the SAME stored dtype it scored, so 'returned score is real cosine' is already only 'real cosine at stored precision' for quantized presets - and pushing below int8 makes that material. Therefore the rerank-fidelity decision (keep an f16 shadow rerank source vs redefine the contract) is the gate for the entire sub-byte roadmap and must land before any 1-bit preset ships. Everything is additive within frozen v1: new encoding ids 4-255, new optional section ids 0x09+, per-section payload-version bumps - no NEST_FORMAT_VERSION bump until a true field-meaning change forces a v2.

pillars.name: Unified in-place retrieval engine (exact + ANN + BM25 + graph + image, one rerank)
pillars.what: One search core over the mmap container where every index is a candidate generator feeding the single mandatory exact-cosine rerank in search.rs. Today: exact f32/f16/int8, hnsw with rerank, bm25 RRF fusion. Add: (a) sub-byte candidate codes (RaBitQ 1-bit popcount-Hamming, int4/PQ asymmetric-LUT) scored off mmap as the coarse stage; (b) Block-Max-WAND/MaxScore top-k pruning so BM25 query cost scales with surviving blocks not corpus size; (c) an optional CSR graph_adjacency section (chunk-to-chunk semantic/citation edges, uint40 ids) traversed with zero alloc, seeding candidates into the same rerank; (d) image vectors land in the SAME L2-normalized embeddings section scored by the identical SIMD dot, so fast image similarity needs zero new distance path. Route HNSW traversal through the existing AVX2/NEON/scalar dispatcher (it currently uses a scalar cosine_dist loop) and replace the per-query HashSet visited set with a generational buffer. The rerank-fidelity contract is made explicit in search_contract.

pillars.name: Embedding compression frontier (int8 -> RaBitQ 1-bit / int4 / PQ), recall-guarded
pillars.what: The embeddings section is the dominant cost and the only never-zstd section, so size only comes from quantization. Ship a tiered ladder behind nest's exact rerank: (1) block-scaled int8 (scale_kind=1, one f16 scale per 32 dims) as a near-free recall+size win reusing the f16 codec, no new encoding id; (2) Rotational Quantization on int8 (seeded Fast Walsh-Hadamard rotate before quantize, store the seed) to gaussianize and lift recall@10 toward ~0.99 at the same 4x; (3) int4 block-64 (~4.25 bpw) and RaBitQ 1-bit (~32x, AND+popcount, ~2 f32 side scalars/vector) as new reserved encoding ids; (4) Matryoshka prefix truncation as a deterministic dimension knob that stacks multiplicatively (256-of-1024 int8 = ~16x vs f32-1024) and shrinks the HNSW graph too. All quantizers must be SEEDED (rotation, PQ k-means) for byte-identical builds. The fused dequant+dot kernel (SQNBitGemm pattern) keeps dequantized values out of RAM. CRITICAL precondition: fix materialize.rs which currently expands EVERY dtype (even int8) to a full n*dim*4 f32 buffer when an HNSW index is present - teach the ANN distance path to score packed codes (or keep f16, not f32) or the codec halves disk but not RAM.

pillars.name: Cold-section structural compression (chunk_ids, spans, postings, adjacency) below zstd
pillars.what: Every non-embedding section carries redundancy zstd only partially removes. Concrete confirmed-in-tree wins: store chunk_ids as 32 raw SHA-256 bytes not 71-byte sha256:<hex> (~2.2x pre-zstd); add a u32 offset table to chunk_ids/canonical/spans for O(1) random access (today materialize/cite scan O(n) length-prefixed strings); delta+zigzag+bitpack the spans byte_start/byte_end (near-monotone u64 -> ~2-4 bytes/chunk) and dedup the repeated source_uri into a string pool referenced by index; delta+bitpack HNSW neighbor ids (sort each list, ~14-17 bits vs 32) and BM25 doc-gap postings + bitpacked tf; front-code / FST the alphabetical BM25 term dictionary (closes the typo and is the seam for CJK/Thai). Build a single reusable scalar bitpack/FOR codec with O(1) select so spans[i]/neighbor[i] stay fetchable by bit-offset off mmap, and a cost-driven per-section chooser (trial-encode raw/zstd/zstd+dict/bitpack, keep smallest measured). These are version-gated by per-section payload versions or new reserved encoding ids - additive, deterministic (sorted inputs, pure-function bit-widths), and never touch the embedding hot path.
draws_from: google/flatbuffers (uoffset table, raw-bytes ids, vtable defaults)

pillars.name: Content-addressed dedup, integrity, and reproducibility at corpus scale
pillars.what: Content-addressing already gives nest the substrate for the biggest whole-repo/whole-database lever: deduplicate identical chunks (and their embeddings) BEFORE zstd, store each unique chunk once with a back-reference array, then zstd the unique pool - and the hard invariant is CDC/dedup on DECOMPRESSED bytes, compress afterward, or the ratio collapses. content_hash must stay invariant (dedup decoder re-expands to identical logical bytes), so citations survive. Add a trained zstd shared dictionary (ZDICT over chunks_canonical, deterministic on sorted samples) to kill cold-start + cross-chunk entropy-table redundancy on the many-short-similar PT-BR chunks. Harden the integrity story: factor the four hand-rolled SHA-256 surfaces into one domain-separated hashing.rs; add BLAKE3 as a NEW additive algorithm-id (never mutating the FROZEN sha256: surfaces) feeding CDC dedup and, for large blobs, a Merkle-root content_hash whose interior CVs verify a single cited chunk span against the root without rehashing the file; add a backward stop-at-last-valid-section recovery validate mode and a Maven-style reproducibility manifest (sorted per-section decoded-length + checksum) so a third party re-derives byte-identity offline.
draws_from: NixOS/nix (NAR dual-identity NarHash/FileHash, store-optimise dedup, CDC-before-compress)

pillars.name: Multi-modal ingestion + real-time edit on a frozen single-file container
pillars.what: Grow the container to swallow text/json/yaml/parquet/pdf/audio/video and whole DBs while keeping single-file/offline/deterministic. (a) Structured docs (json/yaml/parquet cells) as a fixed-stride repr(C) u64 offset tape + separate length-prefixed value blob (simdjson-style) in a reserved section, enabling sub-document citation (nest://content_hash/chunk_id#json_pointer) with zero re-parse; numbers/dates/bools stored native (i56/i128-fixed/ms-epoch) not text. (b) PDF/audio/video reduced to L2-normalized embeddings + canonical text/transcript spans on the existing hot path (no new distance), with heavy payloads optionally dehydrated by content-hash reference. (c) Real-time edit via an append-only typed journal (new reserved section) overlaid in memory at open - the frozen base is never mutated - plus a deterministic nest compact that re-derives a minimal maximally-compressed container (re-run dict, re-quantize, drop dead chunks, rebuild indexes to the smallest preset). Tokenizer upgraded to a byte-level subword pipeline (BPE/Unigram + CJK basic tokenizer) so the token-id stream is itself a corpus-trained compression front-end for text sections AND fixes the CJK/Thai BM25 gap with one shipped model. Distribution: maturin cp312-abi3 single wheel; zero-copy PyBuffer query borrow killing the per-search Vec<f32> alloc; GIL release around the read-only mmap search.
draws_from: PyO3/pyo3 (abi3 wheel, zero-copy PyBuffer, GIL detach)
lancedb/lance (columnar transparent vs opaque encodings, FSST)

plans.compression_strategy: A LAYERED, MODALITY-SPECIFIC CODEC STACK where the layer that decorrelates is split from the layer that entropy-codes, and the embedding hot path is sacred. PER DATA TYPE: (1) TEXT/JSON/YAML (chunks_canonical, provenance, json tape): corpus-trained zstd shared dictionary (ZDICT, deterministic over sorted samples) is the headline lever for many-short-similar PT-BR chunks; optionally a byte-level subword token-id stream BEFORE zstd (domain morphemes generic zstd cannot model) as a new reserved encoding id with byte-exact reversible decode so content_hash is unchanged; FSST as a transparent codec for the text section specifically so single-chunk citation reopen stays O(1) (block-zstd forces whole-section inflate); json/yaml stored as a fixed-stride u64 offset tape + length-prefixed value blob (offset deltas are textbook low-entropy, native-typed scalars kill JSON text bloat) then zstd on the cold parts. (2) EMBEDDINGS (never zstd - scored from mmap): the ONLY axis is quantization, applied as fixed-stride in-place codecs read by stride: block-scaled int8 (scale_kind=1) -> Rotational-Quantized int8 -> int4 block-64 (~4.25 bpw) -> RaBitQ 1-bit (~32x, popcount candidate gen) / PQ8 (asymmetric LUT, 16-32x), each a candidate generator behind the mandatory exact rerank; Matryoshka prefix truncation as an orthogonal multiplicative dim knob; binary/Hamming first-stage gate for a nano preset. PCA-whitening at build time conditions the space so every quantizer loses less at the same bytes. (3) PARQUET/COLUMNAR/DATASETS: column-oriented per-encoding cascade (RLE/FOR/delta/dictionary/bitpack/FSST) chosen by a sampling Analyze pass like DuckDB; integer columns get the shared bitpack/FOR codec with O(1) select; byte-stream-split + zstd for COLD/archival float columns only (never the scored hot path). (4) PDF: extract to canonical text + L2-normalized embeddings (text path above + embedding path), heavy original bytes optionally dehydrated by content-hash reference; spans give byte-exact citation into the source. (5) AUDIO/VIDEO: store CLIP/audio-embedding L2-normalized vectors in the SAME embeddings section (zero new distance), plus transcript/keyframe-caption text on the text path; raw media dehydrated by reference (the container carries the searchable representation, not necessarily the payload). (6) WHOLE-DB/REPO: content-hash dedup of identical chunks/sections BEFORE any codec (Nix store-optimise / IPFS block model; 25-35% from hash equality alone), zstd LDM + level 22 to catch far-apart cross-file duplication the 64KB window misses, FastCDC content-defined chunking so an edit re-emits only touched chunks and unchanged chunks keep byte-identical embeddings (enables cheap incremental/append builds). CROSS-CUTTING RULES: cost-driven per-section selection (trial-encode, keep smallest measured, raw always a candidate so never a regression); decorrelate-then-entropy-code (byte-shuffle/bytedelta in front of zstd on numeric metadata like the int8 scale array and span offsets, NEVER the i8 bodies); a future sovereign in-house FSE/tANS entropy floor for delta-coded BM25 postings and HNSW adjacency. The stack BEATS the field because it compresses AND keeps every byte searchable/citable in place, where generic archivers must inflate to read - and because content-addressing deduplicates across the corpus before the entropy coder ever runs.
plans.format_evolution: STAY ON FROZEN v1; everything below is additive and reserves the v2 bump for a true field-meaning change. THREE ADDITIVE EXTENSION AXES already exist and are sufficient: new ENCODING IDS in reserved 4-255, new SECTION IDS in reserved 0x09+, and per-section PAYLOAD VERSION bumps. NEW ENCODING IDS (in encoding/mod.rs::decode_payload + layout/mod.rs, old readers already reject unknown ids cleanly via UnsupportedSectionEncoding): 4=zstd_dict (trained shared dictionary, dict stored in a new optional SECTION_DICTIONARY=0x09), 5=int4_block64, 6=rabitq1, 7=pq8, 8=delta_bitpack (integer columns: spans/chunk-id-hashes/postings), 9=fsst (transparent text), 10=tokenized (subword id stream), 11=shuffle+zstd (numeric metadata pre-codec). NEW OPTIONAL SECTION IDS (0x09+, excluded from content_hash so they never invalidate citations; reader must skip-unknown-OPTIONAL but error on unknown-REQUIRED via a flags bit on SectionEntry): 0x09=dictionary blob, 0x0A=graph_adjacency (CSR offsets+uint40 neighbor ids+edge_type), 0x0B=chunk_scalars (columnar SoA filter columns), 0x0C=structure_tape (json/yaml u64 tape), 0x0D=tokenizer_model (frozen BPE/Unigram, Darts trie), 0x0E=edit_journal (append-only typed deltas for real-time edit), 0x0F=merkle_index (BLAKE3 parent CVs for partial citation verification), 0x10=fp32_rerank_shadow (optional higher-precision rerank source for sub-byte presets), 0x11=eval_results (self-certified recall). PER-SECTION PAYLOAD-VERSION BUMPS (NOT NEST_FORMAT_VERSION): int8 scale_kind=1 (block-scaled, field already present in int8.rs); HNSW_PAYLOAD_VERSION 1->2 (delta+bitpack neighbor ids + flat fixed-stride uint40 layout); BM25_PAYLOAD_VERSION 1->2 (delta-gap postings + FST term dict). CHUNK_IDS/SPANS get a new encoding id (delta_bitpack/raw-32-byte) rather than a meaning change. INVARIANTS THE EVOLUTION MUST HOLD: (a) content_hash stays over the DECODED canonical six only, and every new codec decodes byte-identically so content_hash and nest:// citations are stable across encodings (verify with a roundtrip assertion per codec); (b) the four sha256: surfaces are FROZEN identity anchors - BLAKE3 enters ONLY as a new algorithm-id, never in-place; (c) embeddings stay scored-from-mmap, so encoding 4/9/11 (zstd/fsst/shuffle) are REJECTED for the embeddings section by an explicit guard; (d) all new codecs are deterministic pure functions (seeded rotation/k-means, sorted samples, fixed bit-widths) so reproducible builds hold. A TRUE v2 (bump NEST_FORMAT_VERSION) is justified ONLY if/when: the rerank-fidelity contract is redefined such that an EXISTING field (search_contract score semantics, or content_hash preimage) changes meaning, OR the header/footer/section-table layout itself must change (e.g. >2^32 sections, a new mandatory section). None of the above requires it; the dual-section sub-byte design (codes in 0x04 + optional shadow in 0x10) deliberately avoids redefining the existing embeddings section so v1 stays frozen.

roadmap.phase: Phase 0 - Foundations and contract honesty (weeks 1-3)
roadmap.goal: De-risk the whole roadmap: make the rerank-fidelity contract explicit, fix the in-place-scoring leak, and land the structural scaffolding every later codec reuses. No new on-disk codec ships yet, but the format-evolution rails and the determinism harness are in place.
workstreams: Resolve and document the rerank-fidelity contract in search_contract: state that real cosine is at stored precision today; reserve optional SECTION_FP32_RERANK_SHADOW=0x10 and a manifest flag so sub-byte presets can rerank against higher precision. This is the GATE for Phase 2.

Fix materialize.rs / ann path: stop expanding int8/f16 to a full n*dim*4 f32 buffer when HNSW is present; teach the ANN distance fn to score against stored codes (or at minimum keep f16). Removes the RAM leak that would otherwise defeat sub-byte codecs.

Route HNSW traversal through the existing AVX2/NEON/scalar dispatcher (replace the scalar cosine_dist loop in ann/mod.rs) and swap the per-query HashSet visited set for a generational Vec<u8>+epoch buffer; pool candidate heaps. Pure latency/correctness win, zero format change.

Build the determinism + quality harness: a benchmark mode reporting nDCG@k/MRR@k/Recall@k vs the exact f32 baseline per preset (MTEB-style, seeded, offline), and a byte-identical-build CI check. This is the safety net that lets every later codec push harder with proof.

Factor the four hand-rolled SHA-256 surfaces into one domain-separated hashing.rs (byte-identical output, validated by existing golden/dual_integrity tests); confirm sha2 0.11 SHA-NI dispatch is on. Establishes the single seam for BLAKE3 later.

Add the additive-format rails: a flags bit on SectionEntry for skippable-OPTIONAL vs unskippable-REQUIRED, reserve encoding ids 4-11 and section ids 0x09-0x11 as named constants, and a roundtrip-equality test template every new codec must pass (decode==input, content_hash stable).

roadmap.phase: Phase 1 - Cold-section structural compression (weeks 3-8)
roadmap.goal: Shrink every non-embedding section below generic zstd while keeping it searchable/citable in place. Lowest risk (never touches the hot path), immediately improves every preset ratio, and builds the reusable integer-codec + offset-table primitives the rest of the plan depends on.
workstreams: Store chunk_ids as 32 raw SHA-256 bytes (encoding or payload change), reconstruct sha256: + hex on decode; ~2.2x pre-zstd, content_hash unchanged.

Build the reusable scalar delta+zigzag+bitpack/FOR codec (encoding id 8) with O(1) select by bit-offset (libfor semantics), single-responsibility files under the 300-line cap, typed thiserror, never-panic on truncated input. Apply to spans (delta byte offsets, ~16 -> ~2-4 bytes/chunk) and dedup the repeated source_uri into a string pool.
Add a u32 offset table at the head of chunk_ids/canonical/spans so materialize/cite reach chunk N in O(1) off mmap instead of O(n) sequential scan; offset deltas are low-entropy and zstd-friendly.
Re-encode HNSW neighbor ids (HNSW_PAYLOAD_VERSION 1->2): sort each list, delta+bitpack (~14-17 bits vs 32), move to a flat fixed-stride uint40 layout; recall unchanged (neighbor SET identical).

Re-encode BM25 postings (BM25_PAYLOAD_VERSION 1->2): delta-gap doc ids + bitpacked tf; front-code/FST the alphabetical term dictionary (BurntSushi fst) - unlocks prefix/typo lookup and is the seam for CJK/Thai.

Add a trained zstd shared dictionary (encoding 4 + SECTION_DICTIONARY=0x09) over chunks_canonical/spans/provenance, trained deterministically in nest-python over sorted samples; add cost-driven per-section selection (trial-encode raw/zstd/zstd+dict/bitpack, keep smallest measured, raw always a candidate).

roadmap.phase: Phase 2 - Embedding compression frontier, recall-guarded (weeks 8-16)
roadmap.goal: Attack the dominant byte cost: take embeddings from int8 (4x) toward 1-bit (32x) behind the exact rerank, shipping a tiered preset ladder (tiny -> micro -> nano) with measured recall non-regression. This is the headline compress-more-than-everyone move on vectors.
workstreams: Land block-scaled int8 (scale_kind=1, one f16 scale per 32 dims) reusing the f16 codec - recovers per-vector-outlier recall loss at the same/near-same size, no new encoding id. Lowest-risk first step that proves the contiguous per-group-scale layout.

Add Rotational Quantization to int8 (seeded Fast Walsh-Hadamard rotate before quantize, store seed; rotate query at search time) to gaussianize and push recall@10 toward ~0.99 at 4x. Fused dequant+dot kernel (SQNBitGemm pattern) keeps dequant out of RAM; add the F16C/VNNI/dotprod fine-grained SIMD tiers.

Ship int4 block-64 (encoding 5, ~4.25 bpw): split pack/unpack from the kernel to stay under the line cap; fused dequant+dot kernel across avx2/neon/scalar; new DType::Int4 arm in score_all/score_subset; deterministic RTN max-abs-per-block (no calibration, byte-identical).

Ship RaBitQ 1-bit (encoding 6) as the coarse candidate codec: seeded rotation + sign bits + ~2 f32 side scalars/vector, AND+popcount kernel (popcnt/vcnt/count_ones) as candidate gen, then the mandatory exact rerank (against the f16/fp32 shadow from Phase 0) produces real cosine. Validate recall@10 on the PT-BR corpus before defaulting.

Add Matryoshka prefix truncation as a deterministic dim knob (manifest mrl_dim/full_dim, renormalize on the prefix) - multiplicative with quantization and shrinks the HNSW graph; two-pass coarse(prefix)-to-fine(full) over the existing rerank.

Add the preset ladder (micro=zstd-dict text + RQ-int8 + hnsw; nano=int4/rabitq + zstd-dict text + hnsw) and a budget->codec inversion in nest-python (target size ratio or recall floor solves dtype/bits/M/ef deterministically). PCA-whitening build-time pass to condition the space.

roadmap.phase: Phase 3 - Corpus-scale dedup, multi-modal ingestion, graph search (weeks 16-26)
roadmap.goal: Turn nest from a per-file engine into a whole-repo/whole-database engine and add the remaining capability pillars (graph traversal, structured/multimodal ingestion) - the compress AND serve everything north star.
workstreams: Content-hash dedup BEFORE zstd: SHA-256 each canonical chunk, store unique chunks once + a u32 back-reference array (encoding-neutral), zstd the unique pool; enforce dedup-on-decompressed-bytes-compress-after as a coded invariant + regression test. content_hash re-expands to identical bytes so citations survive.

FastCDC content-defined chunking (seeded, in nest-python) so an edit re-emits only touched chunks and unchanged chunks keep byte-identical embeddings - enables cheap incremental/append builds and whole-repo ingestion. zstd LDM + level 22 for far-apart cross-file duplication.

Add the CSR graph_adjacency section (0x0A): chunk-to-chunk semantic/citation edges, uint40 ids, delta+bitpacked, traversed with zero alloc; a bounded-BFS search-graph path seeding the SAME exact rerank; 9th nest-cli subcommand. Lets nest drop chunk-overlap text by reconstructing neighbor context from edges.

Structured-doc ingestion: json/yaml as a fixed-stride u64 offset tape + value blob (structure_tape 0x0C, simdjson-style), native-typed scalars, enabling nest://content_hash/chunk_id#json_pointer sub-citation; parquet/dataset columns via the column cascade (Analyze-pick per-column codec).

Multi-modal: CLIP/audio embeddings into the SAME L2-normalized embeddings section (zero new distance) + transcript/caption text on the text path; PDF/audio/video heavy bytes optionally dehydrated by content-hash reference. Tokenizer upgrade to byte-level subword + CJK basic tokenizer (tokenizer_model 0x0D) - doubles as text-compression front-end and fixes CJK/Thai BM25.

BLAKE3 as a new additive algorithm-id + merkle_index (0x0F) for partial-citation verification of large blobs; backward stop-at-last-valid-section recovery validate mode; Maven-style reproducibility manifest.

roadmap.phase: Phase 4 - Real-time edit, distribution, sovereign entropy floor (weeks 26-36)
roadmap.goal: Close the real-time-edit pillar without breaking single-file/deterministic, ship frictionless install, and push the sovereign compression frontier with an in-house entropy stage. Hardening and ergonomics that make the engine adoptable.
workstreams: Append-only edit journal (edit_journal 0x0E): typed add/del chunk deltas overlaid in memory at open (frozen base never mutated), per-Tx rollback; deterministic nest compact re-derives a minimal maximally-compressed container (re-run dict, re-quantize, drop dead chunks, rebuild indexes to smallest preset). Optional in-process RCU double-buffer swap for wait-free hot-reload (never a socket).

Distribution: maturin cp312-abi3 single wheel (+ abi3t free-threaded) to PyPI; zero-copy PyBuffer<f32> query borrow killing the per-search Vec<f32> alloc; Python::detach (GIL release) around the read-only mmap search for free concurrency.

clap ergonomics: Jaro did_you_mean over the 8 subcommands and over real chunk_ids; pure-rust dynamic completion that reads the .nest file (never the python boot path); feature-gated crate split (hnsw/bm25/pyo3 opt-in) for the smallest sovereign binary.

Sovereign in-house FSE/tANS + Huff0 entropy codec (new reserved encoding ids) over delta-coded BM25 postings, HNSW adjacency, and term dictionaries - a deterministic table-build entropy floor below generic zstd on skewed residuals; libdeflate-style two-level decode table for mmap-friendly decode.

PFOR patched exceptions on the integer codec (one huge gap / high-degree node no longer widens the whole block) and a generational functable SIMD dispatch so shuffle/un-delta/f16-convert/i8-widen kernels register without growing match arms past the line cap.

Zone-map / Ribbon-filter skip section (per-block centroid+radius and term membership) so the exact scan and rerank prune blocks that cannot beat the top-k threshold - lets one large .nest stay fast as it grows toward whole-database scale, with exact rerank keeping correctness regardless of false positives.

risks: CONTRACT INTEGRITY (highest): score_subset reranks against the SAME stored lossy dtype, so returned-score-is-real-cosine is already only real-cosine-at-stored-precision. Shipping 1-bit/int4 without the fp32/f16 rerank shadow (or a redefined, documented contract) turns the headline guarantee into a half-truth. Phase 0 must resolve this before any sub-byte preset.

DETERMINISM: every new quantizer (RaBitQ/RQ rotation, PQ/codebook k-means, PCA), dictionary (ZDICT), CDC (rolling-hash seed), and entropy table must be a seeded pure function with fixed iteration order and cross-backend-identical float ops (FMA-vs-mul/add can flip a sign bit near zero in RaBitQ), or same-chunks-same-model-byte-identical-file breaks and citations destabilize. Verify byte-identity across two builds per codec.

IN-PLACE-SCORING LEAK: materialize.rs expands every dtype (even int8) to full n*dim*4 f32 when HNSW is present. If unfixed, sub-byte codecs halve disk but not RAM and forfeit the scored-straight-from-mmap promise - it is a Phase 0 blocker, not a Phase 2 detail.

CONTENT_HASH / CITATION STABILITY: content_hash hashes decoded canonical bytes, so dedup/tokenized/bitpack codecs MUST decode byte-identically (roundtrip assertion per codec) or every nest:// citation breaks; quantized embeddings already make content_hash encoding-dependent for that section - document that cross-precision citation stability does NOT hold and keep the canonical six the stable anchor.

NEVER COMPRESS EMBEDDINGS WITH ZSTD/DEDUP/SHUFFLE: they are scored from mmap; only fixed-stride quantization codecs are legal there. Gate encoding 4/8/9/11 to reject the embeddings section explicitly; the only safe shuffle target is the int8 SCALE array, never the i8 bodies.

SCOPE / LINE-CAP / SOLO-AUTHOR REALITY: <=300 lines/file, single-responsibility, edition-2024, never-panic. Split every codec (pack/unpack/kernel/select) and the SIMD matrix (witness-token generic body) BEFORE multiplying dtypes; the FSE/tANS entropy stage, graph engine, json tape, and edit journal are large surfaces - sequence them so the high-ROI dict+bitpack+int4/rabitq wins land first and the frontier items stay deferrable.

LICENSE HYGIENE: clean-room the algorithms (RaBitQ/PFOR/EF/front-coding/roaring/CDC are public); do NOT vendor GPL/BSL/SSPL/AGPL engines (TurboPFor, Neo4j/GDS, memgraph, FalkorDB core, VectorChord, sqlite-vector) or nightly portable_simd/packed_simd crates; reimplement on nest stable AVX2/NEON/scalar dispatcher.

RECALL CLIFFS + CJK/THAI: 1-bit excels at high dim and can fail at low dim - validate recall@10 on the actual PT-BR demo model before defaulting any nano preset, and keep int8/RQ as the safe default; aggressive vector quantization makes the lexical/BM25 path more load-bearing, so do not ship a 1-bit preset without bm25 (and the tokenizer fix) as a recall backstop.

plans.framing: PRAGMATIC-CHEAP-AND-CLEAN SHIPPING: smallest set of proven techniques per unit of value, tiny deterministic rust core, ships in months with one solo author plus AI agents, every sovereign guarantee (offline / single-file / deterministic / never-panic / additive-v1 / embeddings-scored-from-mmap) held intact. Ruthlessly sequence for fastest time-to-value: ship the cheap lossless integer/string wins first (they cannot regress recall and need no new SIMD), then the one big embeddings lever (block-int8, then int4), then format-hardening and new data types last. Prefer one shared primitive reused across many sections over many bespoke codecs. Reject anything that needs a calibration corpus, a nightly toolchain, an LLM at decode time, a socket, or a heavy native dependency.
plans.thesis: nest's compression frontier is not a better entropy coder; it is four orthogonal, multiplicative levers that the current code leaves almost entirely on the table, each addable additively inside frozen format v1. (1) The non-embedding integer/string sections (chunk_ids store 71-byte ASCII sha256 strings, spans store a full source_uri plus two raw u64 per chunk, bm25 postings store raw u32 doc+tf pairs, hnsw neighbors store raw u32 ids) are the least-compressed bytes in the container and shrink 2-8x losslessly via one shared delta+bitpack/front-code primitive with zero recall risk and no new SIMD. (2) The embeddings section, the dominant and only-never-zstd'd bytes, is floored at int8/4x but its own int8.rs already carries a free scale_kind discriminator: block-scaled int8 (scale_kind=1) recovers outlier recall at the same size, and a new int4 encoding id roughly halves it again under the mandatory exact rerank. (3) Structural dedup of identical chunks before zstd removes cross-document redundancy (PT-BR news boilerplate) that per-section zstd cannot see. (4) The runtime currently undermines its own compression by materializing every dtype to a full n*dim*4 f32 buffer whenever HNSW is present (materialize.rs) and by reranking against the stored lossy dtype not full precision (score_subset) — fixing both is the precondition that makes aggressive quantization actually pay off on disk AND keeps the 'returned score is real cosine' contract honest. The plan ships these in cheapness order, keeps the rust core under its line caps, and treats neural/semantic compression as permanently out of scope because it breaks determinism, offline, and byte-exact citation reopen.

pillars.name: Sovereign lossless core (the always-on win)
pillars.what: One shared, deterministic, never-panic integer-stream primitive — delta(d1)/zigzag + per-128-block minimum-bit-width bitpacking with a varint tail, plus a front-coding string codec and a small dictionary helper — applied ONLY to non-embedding sections: chunk_ids (store 32 raw sha256 bytes then front-code the sorted hex / dedup the 'sha256:' prefix), chunks_original_spans (dedup source_uri into a string pool + delta-code the monotone byte offsets), bm25 postings (delta-gap doc ids + bitpack tf), hnsw neighbor lists (sort+delta+bitpack ids). Pure functions of sorted input so byte-identical builds and stable content_hash hold; decode is branch-free off mmap; never touches the embedding hot path. Highest size/effort ratio in the whole project, zero recall risk.

pillars.name: Embeddings quantization ladder (the dominant lever)
pillars.what: A graceful size/recall ladder on the one section banned from zstd, each rung additive: (rung 0, free) block-scaled int8 as int8.rs scale_kind=1 — one f16 scale per 32-dim block recovers the recall per-vector int8 loses to outliers at ~same size, no new encoding id, no version bump; (rung 1) a new int4 block-scaled encoding id (~4.25 bpw, roughly halves embeddings) with a fused dequant+dot SIMD kernel so dequantized rows never hit RAM; (rung 2, research) RaBitQ 1-bit codes scored by AND+popcount as a candidate stage. Every rung relies on nest's already-mandatory exact-cosine rerank to absorb quantization error, and round-to-nearest-even max-abs-per-block quantization stays deterministic with no calibration corpus.

pillars.name: Honest serve path (compression that actually pays off)
pillars.what: Two runtime fixes that are the precondition for the quantization ladder to matter on disk and to keep the contract truthful: (a) stop materializing the whole embeddings section to a dense n*dim*4 f32 Vec when HNSW is present — teach the ANN distance path to score packed int8/int4 blocks via the fused kernel (or at worst keep f16), eliminating the RAM blow-up that today defeats tiny/hybrid; (b) decouple rerank precision from storage precision — either keep an f16 rerank source section so score_subset reranks against true precision, or explicitly redefine the contract as 'exact cosine at stored precision' and surface dtype in SearchHit. Plus zero-copy PyBuffer<f32> query borrow in nest-python so the int8/int4 wins are not paid back as a per-search Vec<f32> alloc+memcpy at the boundary.

pillars.name: Additive format hardening and new data types (the north-star surface)
pillars.what: Grow the container toward json/yaml/parquet/repos strictly via reserved encoding ids 4-255 and section ids 0x09+, never a v2: a skippable-optional vs unskippable-required flag on section entries so an old runtime serves a newer file with an unknown OPTIONAL section and errors cleanly on an unknown REQUIRED one; a trained shared zstd dictionary section (0x09) for the many-small-similar text chunks; an optional CSR graph_adjacency section for graph search; an optional f16 rerank-source section. content_hash stays over the canonical six so all of this is citation-safe.

pillars.name: Determinism, hygiene and proof (the trust moat)
pillars.what: Hold every hard constraint as the codecs multiply: typed thiserror on every new parse path (reject unknown encoding/version ids cleanly, bounds-check every word read, never panic on malformed mmap bytes); each codec/kernel in its own <=300-line single-responsibility module sharing one spread/table core between encode and decode; seeded/ordered everything (block-32 fixed, ascending-id delta, alphabetical front-code) so same chunks + same model fingerprint stays byte-identical; a reproducibility manifest (sorted per-section decoded_length + content_checksum) and an MTEB-style seeded nDCG@k/Recall@k harness so every compression step ships with measured non-regression instead of a guess.

plans.compression_strategy: A layered codec stack chosen per data type, with embeddings always isolated from the cold path. TEXT/JSON/YAML (chunks_canonical, provenance, search_contract, future structured payloads): build-time content-hash dedup of identical chunks FIRST (collapse duplicates to one stored block + a u32 back-reference array), then front-code sorted string sections, then a trained shared zstd dictionary (ZDICT over canonical chunks fed in sorted order, deterministic), then per-section zstd. Order is load-bearing: dedup/front-code run on DECOMPRESSED bytes, zstd last (the Nix lesson) — inverting it kills the ratio. content_hash hashes the re-expanded decoded bytes so it is invariant. INTEGER/ID SECTIONS (chunk_ids, chunks_original_spans, bm25 postings 0x08, hnsw adjacency 0x07): the shared delta+zigzag+block-bitpack primitive — chunk_ids as 32 raw sha256 bytes (2.2x over 71-byte ASCII) optionally front-coded; spans as a source_uri dictionary + prefix-summed monotone offsets (16 bytes/chunk -> a few bytes/run); bm25 doc-id gaps bitpacked to ~4-8 bits and tf to ~3-4 bits (bump BM25_PAYLOAD_VERSION only); hnsw neighbor ids sorted+delta+bitpacked to ~log2(n) bits (bump HNSW_PAYLOAD_VERSION only). All beat zstd structurally on monotone columns AND keep O(1) random access off mmap. EMBEDDINGS (0x04, the dominant bytes, NEVER zstd, scored straight from mmap): the quantization ladder only — block-scaled int8 (scale_kind=1, f16 scale/32 dims), then int4 block-64 (~4.25 bpw) via fused dequant+dot, then RaBitQ 1-bit candidate codes; symmetric max-abs-per-block RTN, deterministic, recall guarded by the mandatory exact rerank against an f16 rerank source. PARQUET/COLUMNAR/DATASETS (future): per-column codec selection reusing the same integer primitive (FOR/delta for monotone columns, dictionary for low-cardinality enums) plus zstd on the residue; this is where the shared primitive and shared dictionary pay off most, and it stays additive as new optional sections. PDF: canonicalize to deterministic text+spans at build time (build-time only, in python), then it IS the text path — store extracted text in chunks_canonical, byte-spans into the original PDF in chunks_original_spans, so nest://content_hash/chunk_id reopens the exact source bytes; the PDF binary itself, if carried, goes in an optional blob section with content-defined chunking + dedup + zstd. AUDIO/VIDEO: out of scope for the compression core — carry only as opaque CDC-deduped + zstd blob sections (no transcoding, no neural codec), with embeddings of transcript/frame features living in the normal embeddings section; the sovereign guarantee forbids a decode-time model. WHOLE-DB/REPO: content-hash dedup-before-zstd across files is the dominant lever (cross-artifact redundancy dwarfs per-stream gains), composed with the trained shared dictionary and per-column integer codecs; a future dehydrated/manifest mode references stable external sources by content_hash instead of inlining. EXPLICITLY OUT: neural/semantic compression (500xCompressor) — needs an LLM forward pass at decode, breaks determinism (float GPU kernels), offline, single-file, and byte-exact reconstruction; cited only as the boundary nest will not cross.
plans.format_evolution: Stay on frozen format v1; every addition is additive, content_hash stays over the canonical six so citations never break. EVERYTHING below fits inside v1. New EMBEDDING encodings take reserved encoding ids in 4-255: SECTION_ENCODING_INT4 = 4 (block-scaled int4, new manifest dtype 'int4_b64'); reserved 5 for RaBitQ 1-bit later. Block-scaled int8 needs NO new id and NO version bump — it is int8.rs scale_kind=1 behind the existing 8-byte prefix (old readers already reject kind!=0 cleanly via parse()). New NON-EMBEDDING wire encodings also take 4-255: an INTPACK id for delta+bitpack integer sections and a FRONTCODE/DICT id for strings; decode_payload already errors on unknown ids so old binaries fail closed and safe. New SECTIONS take ids 0x09+ and are OPTIONAL (excluded from content_hash, gated by a manifest capability): 0x09 trained zstd dictionary blob; an f16 embeddings rerank-source section; a CSR graph_adjacency section; a chunk_scalars columnar filter section; a chunk_dedup back-reference map. INTERNAL index payloads (0x07 hnsw, 0x08 bm25) re-encode by bumping ONLY their per-section PAYLOAD_VERSION, never NEST_FORMAT_VERSION. One small hardening on SectionEntry: spend a reserved flag bit to mark a section skippable-optional vs unskippable-required so a future reader can serve a newer file's unknown OPTIONAL section and error cleanly on an unknown REQUIRED one — this is a flag on an existing reserved field, additive, no layout change. The ONLY thing that would force a true v2 (bump NEST_FORMAT_VERSION) is changing the MEANING of an existing field — e.g. redefining the content_hash preimage, changing the header/footer/section-table layout, or making an existing canonical section's bytes lossy. None of the roadmap requires that, so v1 carries the entire plan. Guardrail: any new codec on a content-hashed section MUST round-trip byte-exact (decode to identical canonical bytes) or it silently changes content_hash and breaks every citation — enforced by a roundtrip assertion in tests, mirroring the existing zstd/int8/f16 negative tests.
risks: Block-int4 only pays off on disk if the f32 materialization leak in materialize.rs is fixed first; shipping int4 before the ANN distance path scores packed blocks halves disk size but keeps a dense f32 copy in RAM, contradicting score-from-mmap — sequence Phase 2 leak-fix before the int4 preset.

The 'returned score is real cosine' contract is already softened: score_subset reranks against the stored lossy dtype, so 1-bit/int4 without an f16 rerank-source section makes the headline guarantee a half-truth. Decide the rerank-source-vs-redefine-contract question before any sub-int8 preset ships.

Determinism is fragile under new codecs: ZDICT must be fed sorted samples and pinned to a zstd version, bitpack block size fixed, hnsw neighbor lists canonically sorted before delta, RTN block-quant has no seed but float reduction order must not leak — verify byte-identical output across two builds in CI for every codec or reproducible-build + citations break.

Scope/line-cap creep: a fused dequant kernel + nibble pack/unpack + new codec easily blows the 300-line cap and the single-author budget. Split pack/unpack from kernels, share table cores, and resist building the entropy stage / graph / dedup all at once — the roadmap deliberately front-loads the cheap lossless wins.

Any new codec on a content-hashed section that is not byte-exact lossless silently changes content_hash and breaks every nest:// citation; the byte-exact roundtrip assertion must be a hard merge gate, and lossy transforms stay strictly out of the canonical six.

1-bit/4-bit recall is dimension-dependent (great at 1536d, poor at 128-384d); without the MTEB-style harness proving recall@10 on the actual PT-BR demo model, an aggressive preset could ship silently degraded — Phase 0 harness gates every quantization rung.

CJK/Thai bm25 tokenizer degradation is orthogonal to compression and not fixed by any codec here; do not let posting-list compression or a metadata harness mask that the lexical path needs a separate byte-level/subword tokenizer fix.

roadmap.phase: Phase 0 — Foundation and proof (weeks 1-3)
roadmap.goal: Build the measurement and safety scaffolding so every later compression step ships with proof, and land the two zero-risk free wins.
workstreams: Add an MTEB-style seeded quality harness to the existing nest benchmark subcommand: nDCG@k / MRR@k / Recall@k of each preset vs the exact f32 baseline, one small metrics module per metric (<=300 lines), deterministic, offline — converts 'tiny recall@10 0.992' into a reproducible per-preset report.

Add a reproducibility manifest + nest verify-reproducible subcommand: sorted (section_id, decoded_length, content_checksum) list so two builds are proven identical by manifest equality without byte-diffing embeddings; assert byte-identical output across two builds in CI.

Free win 1: chunk_ids store 32 raw sha256 bytes instead of the 71-byte 'sha256:<hex>' ASCII (reconstruct prefix+hex on decode) via a new reserved non-embedding encoding id; ~2.2x on that section, content_hash invariant, roundtrip test.
Free win 2: int8.rs scale_kind=1 block-scaled int8 (f16 scale per 32 dims) — recovers outlier recall at ~same size, no new encoding id, no version bump; gate dim%32 fallback.
Establish the per-codec test discipline: typed thiserror on all new parse paths, negative tests for malformed/truncated bytes, byte-exact roundtrip assertion as the merge gate.

roadmap.phase: Phase 1 — Sovereign lossless core (weeks 4-9)
roadmap.goal: Ship the shared integer/string compression primitive and apply it everywhere off the hot path — the highest size/effort ratio, zero recall risk.
workstreams: Build the shared primitive: encoding/intpack.rs (delta(d1)+zigzag+per-128-block min-bit-width bitpack + varint tail, branch-free scalar decode, never-panic) and encoding/frontcode.rs + a dictionary helper, each single-responsibility under the line cap, sharing one block-header core between encode and decode.

Apply to chunks_original_spans: dedup source_uri into a string pool + prefix-sum the monotone byte offsets (16 bytes/chunk toward a few bytes/run) under a new INTPACK encoding id; decode byte-identical to OriginalSpan so content_hash and citations are unchanged.
Apply to bm25 postings (0x08): delta-gap doc ids + bitpack tf, bump BM25_PAYLOAD_VERSION only, keep alphabetical term order for determinism; front-code the term dictionary.
Apply to hnsw adjacency (0x07): sort+delta+bitpack neighbor ids to ~log2(n) bits, bump HNSW_PAYLOAD_VERSION only, zero recall change (identical neighbor set).

Add the trained shared zstd dictionary section (0x09) + ZstdParams (level, LDM) replacing the hardcoded level-19; train deterministically over sorted canonical chunks; wire cost-driven 'try-all-pick-smallest' per-section selection so a section never loses to raw.

roadmap.phase: Phase 2 — Honest serve path + embeddings ladder rung 1 (weeks 10-16)
roadmap.goal: Make the quantization actually pay off on disk and keep the contract honest, then halve embeddings with int4.
workstreams: Fix the f32 materialization leak: teach the ANN distance path (materialize.rs, ann/mod.rs, ann/search.rs) to score packed int8/int4 blocks via a fused kernel (or at minimum hold f16, not f32), removing the n*dim*4 RAM blow-up that defeats tiny/hybrid today.

Resolve the rerank-precision gap: add an optional f16 rerank-source section (still ~2x smaller than f32) so score_subset reranks survivors against true precision, OR redefine the contract to 'exact cosine at stored precision' and surface dtype in SearchHit — decide and document before any int4 preset ships.

Add int4 block-64 embeddings codec (encoding id 4, dtype 'int4_b64'): one f16 scale per 64-dim block, two int4 codes/byte, ~4.25 bpw; split pack/unpack from the kernel to respect the line cap; deterministic RTN, dim%64 fallback to block-32 int8.

Add the fused dequant+dot SIMD kernel (dot_f32_i4) beside avx2/neon/scalar streaming nibbles + per-block scale + f32 accumulate; assert_instr + forced-scalar parity tests; ship a 'nano' preset (int4 + zstd text + hnsw) only after the quality harness proves recall@10 on the PT-BR corpus.

Zero-copy PyBuffer<f32> query borrow in nest-python (replace query.extract::<Vec<f32>>()), GIL-detach the read-only search, and wire maturin to publish one cp312-abi3 wheel — closes the boundary-overhead and PyPI gaps.

roadmap.phase: Phase 3 — North-star surface: format hardening + new data types (weeks 17-26)
roadmap.goal: Grow toward json/yaml/parquet/repos and graph search, all additive within v1.
workstreams: Add the skippable-optional vs unskippable-required flag bit to SectionEntry so old runtimes serve newer files with unknown OPTIONAL sections and error cleanly on unknown REQUIRED ones; wire skip-or-error in reader/validate.rs.

Add build-time content-hash dedup-before-zstd for chunks_canonical (and cross-file for repo/dataset packing): unique blocks + u32 back-reference array, decode re-expands so content_hash is invariant; the single biggest structural lever for whole-repo/dataset corpora.

Add per-column integer codecs (reusing the Phase-1 primitive) + dictionary-coded low-cardinality enums for an optional structured/columnar section, the parquet/dataset on-ramp; add an optional chunk_scalars filter column for pre-filtering before SIMD scoring (opt-in, never weakens exact rerank).

Add an optional CSR graph_adjacency section (0x09+) over chunk_ids (src/dst u32 + edge_type u8, delta+bitpacked) and a bounded-BFS search-graph path that seeds from exact top-k and re-runs exact cosine rerank — delivers the graph-search pillar at ~9 bytes/edge.

PDF/blob ingestion in python: canonicalize PDF to deterministic text+spans (build-time) feeding the existing text path; carry the original binary, if requested, as an optional CDC-deduped+zstd blob section so citations reopen exact source bytes.

roadmap.phase: Phase 4 — Frontier and stretch (deferred, opt-in)
roadmap.goal: Push past the field on embeddings and entropy, only after the cheap wins ship and the harness justifies the cost.
workstreams: RaBitQ 1-bit embedding codec (reserved encoding id 5) scored by AND+popcount as a candidate stage feeding the existing exact rerank against the f16 source — validate recall@10 per demo model before shipping as a preset (1-bit shines at high dim, fails at low dim).

In-house FSE/tANS entropy stage over delta-coded bm25 postings and hnsw residuals — a sovereign entropy floor below generic zstd; deterministic (table is a pure function of the histogram), but larger surface so lowest priority.

Append-only edit journal + deterministic compact (real-time edit pillar) overlaid in memory at open, never mutating frozen bytes; compact re-runs dedup + trained dict + re-quantize to the smallest preset.
Optional dehydrated/manifest mode for whole-dataset packing: reference stable external sources by content_hash instead of inlining, composed with cross-file dedup.

EXPLICITLY NOT BUILT: neural/semantic (500xCompressor-class) compression, nightly-only SIMD (portable_simd), calibration-corpus quantizers (GPTQ/imatrix), or any socket/server path — each violates a hard sovereign guarantee and is recorded as a deliberate non-goal.

master.vision: nest becomes the most compact, portable, sovereign AI database in the world: a single FROZEN-v1 .nest container that compresses every data type harder than the field while keeping four properties no competitor combines - sovereign/offline (never opens a socket), single-file (one mmap), deterministic (same chunks + same model fingerprint => byte-identical file), and citable (nest://content_hash/chunk_id reopens an exact byte span with a real-cosine score). The thesis, grounded in the actual tree: nest already half-implements the winning pattern - lossy candidate generation guarded by a MANDATORY exact-cosine rerank (search.rs::search_ann/search_hybrid -> score_subset), content_hash over DECODED canonical-six bytes with length-prefixed name-domain framing (a NAR-grade construction), decode_payload that fails closed on unknown encoding ids, an int8 codec that ALREADY carries a scale_kind discriminator (int8.rs:18), and a OnceLock SIMD dispatcher. The unrealized wins are concentrated and verifiable: embeddings are the dominant bytes sitting at an 8 bpw int8 floor while the field has converged on rotation-first sub-byte quantization (block-int8 4x near-lossless, int4 ~4.25bpw, RaBitQ 1-bit ~32x) all guarded by the rerank nest already mandates; the cold metadata sections (chunk_ids as 71-byte ascii, spans as repeated source_uri + raw u64, BM25 raw u32 doc/tf, HNSW raw u32 neighbor ids) carry zero structural compression and are textbook delta+bitpack/front-code/dedup targets; text runs hardcoded level-19 zstd with no trained dictionary; and there is no content-hash dedup before the entropy coder. Two correctness truths gate the aggressive path and are designed in from Phase 0, not bolted on: score_subset reranks against the SAME lossy stored dtype (so 'real cosine' becomes 'real cosine at stored precision' below int8 - sub-int8 REQUIRES a separate f16/f32 rerank source), and materialize.rs expands EVERY dtype to an n*dim*4 f32 buffer whenever HNSW is attached (so any embedding shrink is paid back in RAM unless the ANN path scores packed blocks). Execute the additive codec stack in dependency order behind these two guardrails and nest pushes the tiny preset's 0.283 ratio toward sub-0.1 on embedding-dominated corpora with recall@10 held by the mandatory exact rerank - shipped incrementally by a solo author with AI agents, each codec a <=300-line single-responsibility module returning typed thiserror, every step additive within frozen v1.
master.architecture: Crates stay four: nest-format (frozen container, grows a codec registry + new optional sections), nest-runtime (mmap + ann + bm25 + simd + search + new graph/journal modules), nest-cli (thin clap surface, grows search-graph + verify-reproducible + compact), nest-python (pyo3 abi3 bridge, gains maturin wheel + zero-copy query). CONCRETE FORMAT EVOLUTION, all additive within NEST_FORMAT_VERSION=1: (A) NEW WIRE ENCODING IDS in the reserved 4-255 space (raw=0/zstd=1/float16=2/int8=3 occupied): 4=intpack (delta+zigzag+per-128-block minimal bitpack/FOR with O(1) select, for spans/HNSW/BM25 integer streams), 5=zstd_dict (trained shared dictionary), 6=frontcode (sorted-string front-coding for chunk_ids/bm25 vocab), 7=int4 (block-64 scaled, embeddings only), 8=rabitq (1-bit sign codes + 2 f32 correctors, embeddings only), 9=fsst (transparent text), with shuffle+zstd and tokenized reserved beyond. decode_payload's existing default arm rejects unknown ids with UnsupportedSectionEncoding, so old runtimes fail closed and new runtimes dispatch by id. (B) NEW OPTIONAL SECTION IDS at 0x09+ (0x01-0x08 occupied), all EXCLUDED from content_hash so they never invalidate citations: 0x09=embeddings_fp (f16/f32 rerank source for sub-int8 presets - the honest-rerank gate), 0x0A=dictionary (trained zstd dict blob), 0x0B=dedup_map (content-hash refcount table), 0x0C=graph_adjacency (CSR chunk-to-chunk edges), 0x0D=chunk_scalars (columnar pre-filter: lang/byte_len/source_id), 0x0E=tokenizer_model (frozen vocab for CJK/Thai bm25 + text codec), 0x0F=edit_journal (append-only deltas), 0x10=repro_manifest (sorted per-section content-hash + decoded_length + recipe). (C) PER-SECTION PAYLOAD-VERSION BUMPS (never NEST_FORMAT_VERSION): INT8_PAYLOAD_VERSION/scale_kind=1 (block-int8, the field already exists at int8.rs:18), HNSW_PAYLOAD_VERSION 1->2 (delta+bitpack neighbor ids + flat fixed-stride uint40 layout), BM25_PAYLOAD_VERSION 1->2 (delta-gap postings + bitpacked tf + front-coded/FST term dict). HARDENING that stays additive: a skippable-OPTIONAL vs unskippable-REQUIRED flag bit on SectionEntry (reserved field) so old runtimes serve unknown optional sections and error cleanly on unknown required ones; verify (not just declare) the 64-byte embeddings alignment at reader open for aligned SIMD loads. The decode_payload match in encoding/mod.rs becomes a visitor-style registry where each encoding id is one <=300-line module implementing decode(&[u8])->Cow. THE ONE TRUE v2 (NEST_FORMAT_VERSION=2), deferred to its own research lane and justified only by measured demand: make content_hash a BLAKE3 Merkle root over per-section/per-chunk hashes (changes the meaning of the existing content_hash field, so cannot be additive) for O(touched-bytes) partial verification and single-chunk citation proof; until then SHA-256 over decoded canonical-six stays frozen.
master.compression_strategy: ONE layered codec stack applied per data type, with two invariants: embeddings are NEVER entropy-coded/zstd'd (scored in-place off mmap, shrink only via fixed-stride quantization read by stride); everything else is decorrelated then entropy-coded, codec chosen cost-driven (trial-encode, keep smallest, raw always a candidate) and recorded per section. (1) EMBEDDINGS (dominant bytes, never zstd): a deterministic rotation-first quantization ladder scored in-place and guarded by the mandatory exact rerank against an f16/f32 SECTION_EMBEDDINGS_FP source - (a) block-scaled int8 as int8.rs scale_kind=1, one f16 scale per 32-dim block (near-lossless 4x, NO new encoding id, NO version bump) drawn from ggml block_q8_0 + ARM-software/ComputeLibrary; (b) seeded Fast-Walsh-Hadamard Rotational Quantization on int8 (gaussianize before quantize, push recall@10 toward ~0.99 at 4x, store only the seed) drawn from weaviate/recipes; (c) int4 block-64 ~4.25bpw with a fused dequant+dot kernel that never materializes f32 in RAM (SQNBitGemm pattern) drawn from microsoft/onnxruntime MLAS + ggml Q4_0; (d) RaBitQ 1-bit (sign codes + ~2 f32 correctors, AND+popcount candidate scoring, ~32x, unbiased O(1/sqrt(D)) estimator) drawn from gaoj0017/RaBitQ + VectorDB-NTU/RaBitQ-Library; Matryoshka prefix truncation as a deterministic multiplicative dim knob drawn from QwenLM/Qwen3-Embedding. Integer-domain VNNI/dotprod (vpdpbusd/vdotq_s32) for ~4x speed AND true cross-CPU bit-determinism on the quantized path, drawn from rust-lang/stdarch. (2) INTEGER METADATA (the free wins, never touches hot path): one shared delta(d1)+zigzag+per-128-block minimal-bitpack/FOR codec with O(1) select - HNSW neighbor ids (sort-per-list, ~log2(n) bits vs 32, bump HNSW_PAYLOAD_VERSION), BM25 doc-id gaps + bitpacked tf (bump BM25_PAYLOAD_VERSION), span byte offsets (delta+varint per source) - drawn from lemire/FastPFor + cruppstahl/libfor + fast-pack/simdcomp; patched exceptions (PFOR) so one huge gap/high-degree node never widens a whole block, clean-room from the FastPFor format description (avoid GPL TurboPFor). (3) STRING METADATA: chunk_ids stored as 32 raw SHA-256 bytes not 71-byte ascii (~2.2x), then front-coded; BM25 term dictionary front-coded/FST (BurntSushi/fst, MIT) which ALSO unlocks prefix/typo lookup; deduped source_uri string pool referenced by index - drawn from blazegraph front-coding + google/flatbuffers raw-digest ids + terminusdb-store. (4) TEXT/JSON/YAML (chunks_canonical): build-time content-hash dedup of identical chunks BEFORE zstd (store unique once + u32 back-ref array, the Nix store-optimise lesson - dedup on DECOMPRESSED bytes, compress after) drawn from NixOS/nix + ipfs/kubo; corpus-trained shared zstd dictionary (ZDICT over sorted samples, deterministic) drawn from facebook/zstd + facebook/rocksdb; FSST as a transparent codec so single-chunk citation reopen decodes O(1) without whole-section inflate, drawn from duckdb/duckdb + lancedb/lance; cost-driven per-section selection drawn from duckdb Analyze + ebiggers/libdeflate. (5) PARQUET/COLUMNAR/DATASETS (roadmap): per-column lightweight cascade (RLE/FOR/delta/dictionary/FSST/bitpack) chosen by a deterministic Analyze pass, dictionary-encode low-cardinality enums (verdict/lang) to a few bits, byte-shuffle+zstd on cold numeric planes (Blosc bytedelta), drawn from duckdb + Blosc/c-blosc2. (6) PDF/AUDIO/VIDEO (roadmap): canonicalize PDF to deterministic text before chunking (then it IS the text path), store media payload verbatim addressed by content_hash with a CDC chunk index (copy-without-recode, the Deep Lake lesson), embeddings ride the same quantization ladder, drawn from KaiDMML/FakeNewsNet + activeloopai/deeplake. (7) WHOLE-DB/REPO: content-hash dedup before the entropy coder is the headline structural lever (cross-file duplication dominates), zstd level 22 + long-distance-matching for far cross-file matches, drawn from NixOS/nix. NET: headline single move is rotation-first sub-byte embedding quantization; headline structural move is content-hash dedup before zstd; headline free move is integer-section delta+bitpack; headline text move is trained dictionary + FSST.
master.format_evolution: v1 STAYS FROZEN AND ADDITIVE for the entire compression roadmap. NEST_FORMAT_VERSION is bumped ONLY when an existing field changes meaning. Three additive lanes carry everything, and the in-tree machinery already supports all three. LANE A - NEW WIRE ENCODINGS in reserved 4-255 (raw=0/zstd=1/float16=2/int8=3 occupied): intpack(4), zstd_dict(5), frontcode(6), int4(7), rabitq(8), fsst(9), with shuffle+zstd and tokenized reserved beyond. The existing decode_payload default arm (encoding/mod.rs:50) already rejects unknown ids with UnsupportedSectionEncoding, so an old runtime fails closed and a new runtime dispatches by id - additive by construction. content_hash hashes DECODED canonical-six bytes, so any codec that round-trips bit-exactly yields the SAME content_hash (enforce with a roundtrip+hash-equality test per codec, mirroring the existing zstd_roundtrip_preserves_bytes test); only embeddings are precision-dependent, which is already documented and accepted. LANE B - NEW OPTIONAL SECTIONS at 0x09+ (0x01-0x08 occupied), EXCLUDED from content_hash by the existing spec (layout/mod.rs:101-107) so adding them never invalidates citations: embeddings_fp(0x09, the f16/f32 rerank source that gates sub-int8), dictionary(0x0A), dedup_map(0x0B), graph_adjacency(0x0C), chunk_scalars(0x0D), tokenizer_model(0x0E), edit_journal(0x0F), repro_manifest(0x10), and reserved merkle_index/eval_results beyond. LANE C - PER-PAYLOAD VERSION BUMPS internal to an already-defined section: INT8 scale_kind=1 (the field already exists at int8.rs:18 and parse() already rejects unknown kinds, so old readers stay safe), HNSW_PAYLOAD_VERSION 1->2, BM25_PAYLOAD_VERSION 1->2 - never NEST_FORMAT_VERSION. HARDENING that stays additive: add a skippable-OPTIONAL vs unskippable-REQUIRED flag bit on SectionEntry (a reserved field, no layout change) so old runtimes serve unknown optional sections and error cleanly on unknown required ones; verify the 64-byte embeddings alignment at reader open (SECTION_ALIGNMENT=64 is declared but not verified). THE ONE TRUE v2 (NEST_FORMAT_VERSION=2, deferred to its own research lane, justified ONLY by measured demand for partial/single-chunk citation verification + corpus-level subtree dedup): make content_hash a BLAKE3 Merkle ROOT over per-section/per-chunk hashes instead of a flat SHA-256 over concatenated canonical-six bytes. This CHANGES the meaning of the existing content_hash field (the citation identity anchor), so it cannot be additive - it must be v2 with v1 readers retained. Until then SHA-256 over decoded canonical-six stays frozen and a NEW additive blake3 algorithm-id can be offered for large-blob addressing without touching the v1 default.

pillars.name: Universal layered byte container (the moat)
pillars.what: Make .nest a self-describing additive codec engine: turn decode_payload into a visitor-style registry where each encoding id is one <=300-line module implementing decode(&[u8])->Cow; reserve encoding ids 4-255 and section ids 0x09+ as named constants; add a skippable-OPTIONAL vs unskippable-REQUIRED flag on SectionEntry so old runtimes serve unknown optional sections and fail closed on unknown required ones; cost-driven per-section codec selection (trial-encode all candidates, keep smallest, record chosen id, raw always a candidate). decode_payload already fails closed on unknown ids and content_hash already hashes DECODED canonical-six bytes, so every new codec stays content_hash-stable and citation-safe.

pillars.name: Embedding compression frontier (the dominant bytes)
pillars.what: Drive the embeddings section from the 8 bpw int8 floor down a deterministic rotation-first quantization ladder, all scored in-place off mmap and all guarded by the mandatory exact rerank against a separate f16/f32 rerank-source section: block-scaled int8 (scale_kind=1, near-lossless 4x, no new id) -> seeded-FWHT Rotational Quantization on int8 (~0.99 recall at 4x) -> int4 block-64 (~4.25bpw, fused dequant+dot, no f32 in RAM) -> RaBitQ 1-bit (AND+popcount, ~32x, unbiased estimator). Matryoshka prefix truncation as a deterministic multiplicative dim knob. Rotations/codebooks seeded from the model fingerprint -> byte-identical builds. Integer-domain VNNI/dotprod kernels for speed AND true cross-CPU bit-determinism on the quantized path.

pillars.name: Integer + string metadata compression (the free wins)
pillars.what: Replace structurally-uncompressed cold sections with canonical integer/string codecs, all decoding byte-identically so content_hash and citations are unchanged: one shared delta(d1)+zigzag+per-128-block minimal-bitpack/FOR codec with O(1) select for HNSW neighbor ids (sort-per-list), BM25 doc-id gaps + bitpacked tf, and per-source span offsets; 32 raw SHA-256 digest bytes instead of 71-byte ascii chunk_ids (~2.2x) with front-coding/FST term+id dictionary that stays binary-searchable off mmap; a deduped source_uri string pool. Index changes bump only HNSW/BM25 payload versions; spans/chunk_ids use a new reserved encoding id. PFOR patched exceptions so one giant gap never widens a block.

pillars.name: Text + structured-document codec stack (compress-AND-serve everything)
pillars.what: Beat generic zstd on text by ordering the stack correctly: content-hash dedup of identical chunks BEFORE zstd (Nix lesson: dedup on decompressed bytes, compress after); a corpus-trained shared zstd dictionary (ZDICT over sorted samples, deterministic) to kill per-section cold-start + cross-chunk redundancy on many-short-similar PT-BR chunks; FSST as a transparent codec so single-chunk citation reopen decodes O(1) where block-zstd forces a whole-section inflate; cost-driven pick-smallest per section; and for the json/yaml/parquet roadmap a fixed-stride u64 structural tape + length-prefixed value blob plus per-column lightweight codec cascade chosen by a deterministic Analyze pass. Canonical text stays byte-exact so content_hash is stable.

pillars.name: Honest serve path + sovereign runtime guarantees
pillars.what: Two runtime fixes are the precondition for compression to actually pay off and stay honest: (a) fix the materialize-to-f32 leak so the ANN distance path scores packed int8/int4 blocks (or keeps f16, never expands to n*dim*4 f32 in RAM); (b) decouple rerank precision from storage precision via a SECTION_EMBEDDINGS_FP rerank source so score_subset reranks survivors against true precision below int8. Plus: generalize the SimdBackend OnceLock into a functable so new kernels (f16/F16C, VNNI/dotprod, popcount, nibble-unpack) register one entry each; route HNSW traversal through the SIMD dispatcher instead of the scalar cosine_dist loop and swap the per-query HashSet visited set for a generational buffer; zero-copy PyBuffer<f32> query borrow + Python::detach around the read-only mmap search; one cp312-abi3 maturin wheel.

pillars.name: Corpus dedup, graph search, real-time edit + reproducibility
pillars.what: Add the structural and capability pillars as cheap additive overlays: content-defined chunking (FastCDC/Gear, seeded) + content-hash dedup with refcounts (the field's biggest lever on whole-repo/dataset payloads); an optional CSR graph_adjacency section (chunk-to-chunk semantic/citation/NEXT_CHUNK edges, reusing the intpack codec) traversed off mmap, seeded from exact-cosine top-k and feeding the SAME mandatory exact rerank (and letting nest drop chunk-overlap text by reconstructing neighbor context from edges); an append-only edit journal overlaid in memory at open (frozen bytes immutable) plus a deterministic compact() that re-runs the dictionary, re-quantizes, drops dead chunks; a reproducibility manifest (sorted per-section content-hash + decoded_length + recipe) making byte-identical builds third-party verifiable offline; a byte-level subword tokenizer closing the CJK/Thai BM25 gap and doubling as a text-compression front-end.

roadmap.phase: Phase 0 - guardrails + scaffolding (unblock everything, zero ratio yet)
roadmap.title: Make the format a clean additive codec engine and remove the two correctness/RAM blockers before any codec
roadmap.goal: De-risk the whole roadmap: resolve the rerank-fidelity contract, fix the in-place-scoring leak, land the reproducibility/determinism harness, and reserve the additive-format rails - so every later codec ships behind proven guardrails.

workstreams.name: Honest-rerank gate + RAM-leak fix
tasks: Reserve SECTION_EMBEDDINGS_FP=0x09 (optional f16/f32 rerank source, excluded from content_hash) and plumb it through the writer + manifest capability
Make score_subset rerank against embeddings_fp when present (not the stored lossy dtype), keeping today's behavior when absent
Teach the ANN distance path to score packed int8 blocks (or keep f16) so materialize_f32_vectors no longer expands every dtype to n*dim*4 f32 when HNSW is attached
Document in search_contract: 'real cosine at stored precision' unless an fp rerank source is present
workstreams.risk: Touching score_subset/materialize risks regressing the exact-rerank ground truth; gate with the golden recall harness and assert byte-identical results on f32 corpora before/after.

workstreams.name: Codec registry refactor + cost-driven selection
tasks: Turn encoding/mod.rs decode_payload into a visitor-style registry where each encoding id is one <=300-line module implementing decode(&[u8])->Cow
Reserve encoding ids 4-9 and section ids 0x09-0x10 as named constants in layout/mod.rs (no behavior change)
Generalize writer encoding_choice.rs + payload.rs from a binary raw-vs-zstd switch into a deterministic try-all-pick-smallest chooser recording the chosen id per section (raw always a candidate)
workstreams.risk: Registry churn could break the frozen wire format; the refactor must be byte-identical on existing presets, enforced by the golden/v01_compat tests.

workstreams.name: SIMD functable + alignment verify
tasks: Generalize the SimdBackend OnceLock into a functable struct of fn pointers so new kernels register one entry each, keeping each simd/*.rs under 300 lines
Add an F16C tier to the AVX2 f16 path (vcvtph2ps) so the compressed/tiny f16 preset stops falling back to scalar on x86
Verify 64-byte embeddings alignment at reader open; keep NEST_FORCE_SCALAR parity tests with exact-equality where integer-domain
workstreams.risk: A missed #[inline(always)] silently de-optimizes the hot loop; gate the refactor with assert_instr-style disassembly checks and the existing simd parity tests.

workstreams.name: Reproducibility + per-codec roundtrip gates + distribution
tasks: Add a roundtrip+content_hash-equality test template every new codec must pass (decode==input, content_hash stable)
Add an MTEB-style seeded quality harness to the benchmark subcommand: nDCG@k/MRR@k/Recall@k vs the exact f32 baseline per preset, plus a byte-identical-build CI check
Reserve SECTION_REPRO_MANIFEST=0x10 (sorted per-section content-hash + decoded_length + recipe) and a verify-reproducible subcommand
Wire a maturin cp312-abi3 wheel + zero-copy PyBuffer<f32> query borrow + Python::detach around the read-only mmap search
workstreams.risk: MTEB metrics need qrels the PT-BR demo lacks; build a seeded synthetic/hand-labeled qrels set or the nDCG numbers are vacuous (recall-vs-exact-f32 overlap works with zero labels as the interim).

roadmap.phase: Phase 1 - the free integer + string wins (ship ratio at near-zero risk)
roadmap.title: Compress the structurally-uncompressed cold metadata sections, all decoding byte-identically
roadmap.goal: Shrink every non-embedding integer/string section below generic zstd while keeping it searchable/citable in place, building the reusable integer-codec + front-code primitives the rest of the plan depends on. Lowest risk - never touches the hot path or recall.

workstreams.name: Shared intpack integer codec
tasks: Build encoding/intpack.rs: delta(d1)+zigzag+per-128-block minimal-bitpack with a varint tail and O(1) select by bit-offset (FOR semantics), branch-free scalar decode, never panic on truncated input
Register SECTION_ENCODING_INTPACK=4; add PFOR patched-exceptions variant clean-room from the FastPFor format description (avoid GPL TurboPFor)
workstreams.risk: Bit-cursor/varint reads on malformed mmap bytes must return typed thiserror, never index-panic; cover with negative tests mirroring negative_zstd/negative_int8.

workstreams.name: HNSW + BM25 index re-encoding
tasks: HNSW neighbor ids: sort-per-list + delta+bitpack in ann/codec.rs, move to flat fixed-stride uint40 layout, bump HNSW_PAYLOAD_VERSION 1->2 (identical id set => zero recall change)
BM25 postings: delta-gap doc ids + bitpacked tf + 1-byte log-quantized doc_lengths in bm25/codec.rs, bump BM25_PAYLOAD_VERSION 1->2
Front-code or FST the alphabetical BM25 term dictionary (unlocks prefix/typo lookup, seam for CJK/Thai)
workstreams.risk: HNSW neighbor lists must be canonically sorted before delta or on-disk bytes vary across builds; assert byte-identical to_bytes across two builds (the existing deterministic_build_same_seed test extends here).

workstreams.name: chunk_ids + spans + frontcode
tasks: Store chunk_ids as 32 raw SHA-256 digest bytes (reconstruct sha256:<hex> on decode) via SECTION_ENCODING_FRONTCODE=6; ~2.2x, content_hash unchanged because decoded ids are identical
Re-encode chunks_original_spans: dedup source_uri into a string pool + delta+varint per-source monotone byte offsets via intpack; decode byte-identical to OriginalSpan
Add a u32 offset table at the head of chunk_ids/canonical/spans so cite/materialize reach chunk N in O(1) off mmap instead of an O(n) length-prefixed scan
workstreams.risk: content_hash must stay invariant across the chunk_ids encoding switch (it hashes the decoded canonical representation); add a roundtrip assertion that the decoded ids equal the old ascii form.

roadmap.phase: Phase 2 - text dictionary + the safe embedding step (headline ratio levers)
roadmap.title: Beat generic zstd on text and take the first near-lossless embedding compression step that needs no rerank source
roadmap.goal: Land the two biggest near-term ratio levers that carry no recall risk: a trained shared text dictionary + FSST, and block-scaled/rotational int8 that recovers recall at the same 4x size without needing the fp rerank source.

workstreams.name: Trained dictionary + FSST text codec
tasks: Train a shared zstd dictionary build-time (ZDICT over sorted chunks_canonical/spans/provenance/bm25 terms, deterministic pure function); store in SECTION_DICTIONARY=0x0A, encode text via SECTION_ENCODING_ZSTD_DICT=5
Add FSST transparent text codec (SECTION_ENCODING_FSST=9) so single-chunk citation reopen decodes O(1) without whole-section inflate; chosen vs zstd_dict by the cost-driven selector
Replace hardcoded zstd level-19 with level/LDM knobs (level 22 + long-distance-matching for large whole-db/repo payloads)
workstreams.risk: ZDICT must be fed sorted/identical samples and pinned to a zstd version or reproducible builds break; verify byte-identical output across two builds.

workstreams.name: Block-scaled + rotational int8
tasks: Add int8 scale_kind=1 (one f16 scale per 32-dim block) reusing the float16 codec for scales: near-lossless 4x with NO new encoding id and NO format bump (the field already exists at int8.rs:18)
Add seeded FWHT Rotational Quantization before quantize (gaussianize, push recall@10 toward ~0.99 at 4x, store only the seed; rotate query at search time via a shared fwht helper)
Wire integer-domain VNNI/dotprod kernels (vpdpbusd/vdotq_s32) for ~4x speed and true cross-CPU bit-determinism on the int8 path
workstreams.risk: FWHT rotation determinism hinges on identical float ops across SIMD backends (FMA-vs-mul/add can flip a sign near zero); compute rotation backend-independently at build time, verify byte-identical codes across two builds and across backends.

workstreams.name: Matryoshka + micro preset
tasks: Build-time Matryoshka prefix truncation + L2-renormalize to mrl_dim (manifest fields, multiplicative with int8), two-pass coarse(prefix)->exact(full) search
Ship a micro preset (zstd_dict/FSST text + block/RQ-int8 + hnsw) below tiny's 0.283 and report measured recall@10 vs exact
workstreams.risk: Matryoshka needs an MRL-trained model AND per-prefix L2-renorm; skipping the renorm silently corrupts cosine - bake it into the writer or the score path and validate recall on the demo model.

roadmap.phase: Phase 3 - sub-byte embeddings + corpus dedup (push toward sub-0.1)
roadmap.title: Cross the int8 floor with rotation-first sub-byte quantization and add dedup before the entropy coder
roadmap.goal: Take embeddings below int8 (int4 then RaBitQ 1-bit) guarded by the Phase-0 fp rerank source, and add the content-hash dedup that attacks redundancy before zstd - the deepest compression levers, now safe to ship.

workstreams.name: int4 + fused dequant kernel
