tasks: Add SECTION_ENCODING_INT4=7 block-64 codec (~4.25bpw) with split pack/unpack and a fused dequant+dot kernel (SQNBitGemm pattern) that never materializes f32 in RAM; DType::Int4 arm in score_all/score_subset
Deterministic RTN max-abs-per-block (no calibration corpus); dim%64 fallback to block-32 int8
Optional build-time PCA-whitening before quantize for free quality (rotation stored in provenance)
workstreams.risk: Without the Phase-0 fp rerank source int4 makes the contract a half-truth; gate the int4 preset on embeddings_fp being present, and verify it scores packed blocks (no f32 RAM blow-up).

workstreams.name: RaBitQ 1-bit + nano preset
tasks: Add SECTION_ENCODING_RABITQ=8: seeded rotation + sign bits + ~2 f32 correctors, AND+popcount kernel (popcnt/vcnt/count_ones) as candidate generation, then mandatory exact rerank against embeddings_fp -> real cosine
Store the rotation as a seeded FHT (O(D log D), store the seed not a dense matrix); validate recall@10 on the PT-BR corpus before defaulting
Ship a nano preset; keep int8/RQ as the safe default and never ship a 1-bit preset without bm25 as a recall backstop
workstreams.risk: 1-bit excels at high dim and can fail at low dim; validate recall@10 on the actual demo model first and keep it opt-in, never the default.

workstreams.name: Content-hash dedup before zstd
tasks: Build-time content-hash dedup of identical chunks_canonical (store unique once + a u32 back-reference array in SECTION_DEDUP_MAP=0x0B); run on DECOMPRESSED bytes, zstd the unique pool after
Encode 'dedup-then-compress, never compress-then-dedup' as a code-level invariant + regression test; decode re-expands to identical bytes so content_hash and citations are invariant
Add SECTION_CHUNK_SCALARS=0x0D columnar pre-filter (lang/byte_len/source_id, low-cardinality enums dictionary-coded) scanned before SIMD scoring, opt-in so it never weakens the exact rerank
workstreams.risk: Inverting the order (compress then dedup) collapses the ratio to near-zero; encode the invariant as a test, and never dedup/CDC the embeddings section (breaks contiguous SIMD layout).

roadmap.phase: Phase 4 - structured docs, graph search, edit + the v2 decision
roadmap.title: Extend compress-AND-serve to json/yaml/parquet and whole-repos, add graph search and real-time edit, and only now evaluate the one true v2
roadmap.goal: Deliver the remaining north-star pillars as additive overlays and gate the single justified v2 (BLAKE3 Merkle content_hash) on measured demand.

workstreams.name: Structured tape + columnar cascade
tasks: Add SECTION_STRUCTURE_TAPE (fixed-stride u64 tape + length-prefixed value blob, simdjson-style) + min-width offset tables + key-interning for json/yaml/parquet, sub-document citable (nest://content_hash/chunk_id#json_pointer)
Per-column DuckDB-style codec cascade (RLE/FOR/delta/dictionary/FSST/bitpack) chosen by a deterministic Analyze pass; byte-shuffle+zstd on cold numeric planes
Canonicalize PDF to deterministic text before chunking (build-time, Python); store media verbatim by content_hash with a CDC chunk index (copy-without-recode)
workstreams.risk: Any SIMD structural scanner needs input padding so 64-byte loads never read past the mmap; use a portable parity scan (no PCLMULQDQ dependency) for cross-CPU determinism.

workstreams.name: Graph search + neighbor-context dedup
tasks: Add SECTION_GRAPH_ADJACENCY=0x0C (CSR chunk-to-chunk semantic/citation/NEXT_CHUNK edges, reusing intpack); bounded-BFS seeded from exact-cosine top-k feeding the SAME exact rerank
Drop chunk_overlap text from chunks_canonical by reconstructing neighbor context from NEXT_CHUNK edges
Add a 9th CLI subcommand search-graph mirroring search-ann
workstreams.risk: Do not vendor SSPL/GPL graph engines; clean-room the CSR + bounded-BFS from public descriptions. Graph traversal must only generate candidates, never change returned scores.

workstreams.name: Real-time edit + sovereign tokenizer
tasks: Add SECTION_EDIT_JOURNAL=0x0F append-only deltas overlaid in memory at open (frozen bytes immutable) + a deterministic compact() re-running ZDICT, re-quantizing, dropping dead chunks, rebuilding indexes to the smallest preset
Add SECTION_TOKENIZER_MODEL=0x0E byte-level subword tokenizer (byte_fallback + reversible markup) closing the CJK/Thai BM25 gap and serving as a token-id text codec
Optional sovereign static embedder (model2vec/POTION) for offline re-embed of queries and edited chunks
workstreams.risk: The edit journal must never mutate frozen bytes and compact must be byte-identical for the same live set; the tokenizer vocab must be frozen and fingerprinted or builds destabilize.

workstreams.name: v2 evaluation (deferred research lane)
tasks: Prototype content_hash as a BLAKE3 Merkle root behind a NEST_FORMAT_VERSION=2 gate with v1 readers retained, justified only by measured demand for partial/single-chunk citation verification + corpus-level subtree dedup
Ship SECTION_MERKLE_INDEX (chunk-group parent CVs) and SECTION_EVAL_RESULTS (self-certified nDCG/recall per preset) additively FIRST, before any v2 bump
Offer a new additive blake3 algorithm-id for large-blob addressing without touching the v1 default
workstreams.risk: A v2 bump changes the citation identity anchor; defer until additive merkle_index proves demand, and retain v1 readers forever.

cards.title: Land SECTION_EMBEDDINGS_FP=0x09 rerank source + make score_subset use it
cards.detail: The gate for all sub-int8 work. score_subset (search.rs:84-121) reranks against the SAME lossy stored dtype today, so below int8 'real cosine' silently becomes 'real cosine at stored precision'. Reserve an optional f16/f32 rerank-source section (excluded from content_hash) and rerank survivors against it when present. Additive, no version bump.

cards.title: Fix materialize-to-f32 RAM leak in the ANN distance path
cards.detail: materialize_f32_vectors (materialize.rs:32-41) expands EVERY dtype to n*dim*4 f32 whenever HNSW is attached (mmap_file.rs:113), so int8/int4 halve disk but keep a dense f32 copy in RAM on exactly the tiny/hybrid presets that need it. Teach the ANN path to score packed int8 blocks (or keep f16). Pure runtime fix, no format change.

cards.title: Codec registry refactor + reserve encoding ids 4-9 / section ids 0x09-0x10
cards.detail: Turn decode_payload (encoding/mod.rs:44-55) into a visitor-style registry, one <=300-line module per encoding id; reserve the named constants in layout/mod.rs. Must be byte-identical on existing presets (golden/v01_compat tests). Unblocks every later codec.

cards.title: Per-codec roundtrip+content_hash-equality test template + MTEB-style recall harness
cards.detail: Every new codec must pass decode==input AND content_hash-stable (mirror zstd_roundtrip_preserves_bytes). Extend benchmark with seeded nDCG/MRR/Recall@k vs exact f32 baseline per preset + a byte-identical-build CI check. The safety net that lets later codecs push harder with proof.

cards.title: Shared intpack codec (delta+zigzag+per-128-block bitpack/FOR with O(1) select)
cards.detail: SECTION_ENCODING_INTPACK=4, the reusable primitive for HNSW/BM25/spans. Branch-free scalar decode, never panic on truncated input, O(1) select by bit-offset so spans[i]/neighbor[i] stay fetchable off mmap. Clean-room PFOR exceptions from the FastPFor format description (avoid GPL TurboPFor).

cards.title: Re-encode HNSW neighbor ids + BM25 postings with intpack
cards.detail: Sort-per-list + delta+bitpack HNSW neighbor ids (flat uint40, bump HNSW_PAYLOAD_VERSION, identical id set => zero recall change). Delta-gap BM25 doc ids + bitpacked tf + 1-byte log-quantized doc_lengths (bump BM25_PAYLOAD_VERSION). Biggest free shrink of the tiny/hybrid index sections.

cards.title: chunk_ids as 32 raw SHA-256 bytes + spans source_uri dedup + offset tables
cards.detail: Store 32 raw digest bytes not 71-byte ascii (~2.2x, reconstruct sha256:<hex> on decode, content_hash unchanged). Dedup repeated source_uri into a string pool + delta+varint span offsets. Add a u32 offset table so cite/materialize reach chunk N in O(1) instead of an O(n) scan.

cards.title: Trained shared zstd dictionary + FSST + zstd level/LDM knobs
cards.detail: SECTION_DICTIONARY=0x0A + SECTION_ENCODING_ZSTD_DICT=5 (ZDICT over sorted samples, deterministic) kills cross-chunk redundancy on many-short-similar PT-BR chunks. FSST (id 9) for O(1) single-chunk citation reopen. Replace hardcoded level-19 (zstd_codec.rs:10) with level/LDM params. Headline text ratio lever.

cards.title: Block-scaled + rotational int8 (scale_kind=1, no new id, no version bump)
cards.detail: One f16 scale per 32-dim block recovers per-vector-outlier loss at the same 4x size; seeded FWHT rotation before quantize pushes recall@10 toward ~0.99. The int8 scale_kind field already exists at int8.rs:18 and parse() rejects unknown kinds, so old readers stay safe. Pair with VNNI/dotprod for bit-determinism.

cards.title: Zero-copy PyBuffer query + maturin cp312-abi3 wheel
cards.detail: Replace query.extract::<Vec<f32>>() (nest_file.rs:23) with a PyBuffer<f32> borrow + Python::detach around the read-only mmap search; ship one cp312-abi3 wheel to PyPI. Stops the compression wins being paid back as per-search alloc+memcpy, and closes the install gap.

cards.title: int4 block-64 codec + fused dequant+dot kernel
cards.detail: SECTION_ENCODING_INT4=7 (~4.25bpw), split pack/unpack from kernel, fused SQNBitGemm-style kernel that never materializes f32 in RAM, DType::Int4 arm. Gate the preset on the embeddings_fp rerank source being present. Roughly halves embeddings vs int8.

cards.title: RaBitQ 1-bit codec + popcount kernel + nano preset
cards.detail: SECTION_ENCODING_RABITQ=8: seeded FHT rotation + sign bits + ~2 f32 correctors, AND+popcount candidate gen, then exact rerank against embeddings_fp -> real cosine. ~32x. Validate recall@10 on the PT-BR demo model before defaulting; keep int8/RQ the safe default and never ship without bm25 backstop.

cards.title: Content-hash dedup before zstd + chunk_scalars pre-filter
cards.detail: Build-time dedup of identical chunks (SECTION_DEDUP_MAP=0x0B, unique pool + u32 back-ref) on DECOMPRESSED bytes, zstd after - encode the order as a code-level invariant + test. Re-expand to identical bytes so content_hash/citations invariant. Add SECTION_CHUNK_SCALARS=0x0D columnar pre-filter, opt-in.

cards.title: Matryoshka prefix truncation + micro/nano preset ladder
cards.detail: Build-time truncate+L2-renorm to mrl_dim, two-pass coarse(prefix)->exact(full) search, multiplicative with quantization. Ship micro (block/RQ-int8) and nano (int4/rabitq) presets below tiny's 0.283 with measured recall.

cards.title: CSR graph_adjacency section + search-graph subcommand
cards.detail: SECTION_GRAPH_ADJACENCY=0x0C (chunk-to-chunk edges, reusing intpack), bounded-BFS seeded from exact top-k feeding the SAME exact rerank. Lets nest drop chunk_overlap text by reconstructing neighbor context from NEXT_CHUNK edges. Delivers the graph-search pillar.

cards.title: Byte-level subword tokenizer for CJK/Thai BM25 + text front-end
cards.detail: SECTION_TOKENIZER_MODEL=0x0E, byte-level BPE/Unigram + byte_fallback + reversible markup. Closes the documented CJK/Thai BM25 gap (bm25/tokenize.rs word-segmenter) and doubles as a token-id text compression front-end. Vocab frozen + fingerprinted for determinism.

cards.title: Append-only edit journal + deterministic compact()
cards.detail: SECTION_EDIT_JOURNAL=0x0F overlaid in memory at open (frozen bytes immutable) + compact() re-running ZDICT/re-quantize/drop-dead-chunks to the smallest preset. Same live set => byte-identical output. Delivers real-time edit without breaking single-file/determinism.

cards.title: BLAKE3 Merkle-root content_hash (the one true v2)
cards.detail: Make content_hash a Merkle root over per-section/per-chunk hashes for O(touched-bytes) partial verification + single-chunk citation proof + corpus-level subtree dedup. Changes the meaning of an existing field, so it MUST be NEST_FORMAT_VERSION=2 with v1 readers retained. Ship SECTION_MERKLE_INDEX + a new additive blake3 algorithm-id FIRST; bump only on measured demand.

cards.title: Structured tape (json/yaml/parquet) + per-column codec cascade
cards.detail: Fixed-stride u64 tape + length-prefixed value blob (simdjson-style) + min-width offsets + key-interning, sub-document citable. Per-column DuckDB-style Analyze-and-pick cascade. Portable parity scan (no PCLMULQDQ) for cross-CPU determinism. The compress-AND-serve-structured-data lever.

cards.title: Sovereign in-house FSE/tANS entropy floor over delta-coded postings
cards.detail: In-house FSE/tANS + Huff0 (new reserved encoding ids) over delta-coded BM25 postings, HNSW adjacency, term dictionaries - a deterministic table-build entropy floor below generic zstd on skewed residuals; libdeflate-style two-level decode table for mmap-friendly decode. Larger surface, lowest priority.

cards.title: PDF/audio/video ingestion + copy-without-recode media payloads
cards.detail: Canonicalize PDF to deterministic text before chunking (then it IS the text path), store media verbatim by content_hash with a CDC chunk index (never lossy-re-encode inside the container), CLIP-style L2-normalized media embeddings ride the same quantization ladder. FastCDC content-defined chunking for edit-local rechunking.

cards.title: Algorithm-4 diversity neighbor selection + generational visited set
cards.detail: Replace the _simple top-m HNSW neighbor selection (ann/mod.rs:33 flags this as planned) with Malkov-Yashunin Algorithm-4 so recall rises at fixed M, letting tiny/nano presets LOWER M and shrink the index. Route traversal through the SIMD dispatcher and swap the per-query HashSet for a generational buffer.

risks: CONTRACT INTEGRITY (highest): score_subset (search.rs:84-121) reranks against the SAME lossy stored dtype, so 'returned score is real cosine' is already only 'real cosine at stored precision' for quantized presets. Shipping int4/RaBitQ/PQ without the SECTION_EMBEDDINGS_FP rerank source turns the headline guarantee into a half-truth - Phase 0 MUST land the fp rerank source before any sub-int8 preset.

IN-PLACE-SCORING RAM LEAK: materialize_f32_vectors (materialize.rs:32-41) expands every dtype to n*dim*4 f32 whenever HNSW is attached (mmap_file.rs:113), so a 4-bit codec halves disk but keeps a dense f32 copy in RAM on exactly the tiny/hybrid presets that need it. The ANN distance path must score packed blocks (or keep f16) or the compression win is paid back in memory - a Phase-0 blocker, not a Phase-3 detail.

DETERMINISM: every seeded/iterative quantizer (FWHT/FHT rotation, PCA, RaBitQ rotation, FastCDC mask, ZDICT, k-means) must be a pure seeded fixed-iteration stable-tie-break function or 'same chunks + same model fingerprint => byte-identical file' breaks. Float horizontal-sum is non-associative (FMA-vs-mul/add can flip a sign near zero), so compute build-time codes backend-independently and verify byte-identical output across two builds AND across SIMD backends per codec; do NOT adopt calibration that depends on a calibration corpus.

CODEC/DEDUP ORDERING is load-bearing: dedup and CDC MUST run on DECOMPRESSED bytes with compression applied per unique block AFTER, or the dedup ratio collapses to near-zero. Encode this as a code-level invariant + regression test, not a comment.

NEVER compress/dedup/shuffle the embeddings section with zstd/CDC: they are scored from mmap on the SIMD hot path; only fixed-stride quantization codecs are legal there (the only safe shuffle target is the int8 SCALE array, never the i8 bodies). Gate non-embedding encodings to reject the embeddings section explicitly.

content_hash / citation stability: content_hash hashes DECODED canonical bytes, so dedup/intpack/frontcode codecs MUST decode byte-identically or every nest:// citation breaks; quantized embeddings already make content_hash encoding-dependent for that section, which is documented and accepted - keep the canonical six the stable anchor and never claim cross-precision citation stability.

SCOPE / LINE-CAP / SOLO-AUTHOR REALITY: <=300 lines/file (333 hard), single-responsibility, edition-2024, never-panic typed thiserror including on malformed/truncated mmap bytes. Split every codec (pack/unpack/kernel/select) and do the SIMD functable refactor BEFORE multiplying dtypes; sequence the high-ROI dict+bitpack+int8 wins first and keep the FSE/tANS entropy stage, graph engine, json tape, and edit journal deferrable.

LICENSE CONTAMINATION: clean-room from format descriptions/papers - TurboPFor (GPL), VectorChord/sqlite-vector (AGPL/ELv2), Neo4j/GDS/memgraph/FalkorDB/blazegraph (GPL/BSL/SSPL), nightly portable_simd/packed_simd ports. Reimplement on nest's stable AVX2/NEON/scalar dispatcher; the algorithms (RaBitQ/PFOR/FOR/front-coding/CDC) are public, the engines are not. License-vet every demo dataset (FEVER/TabFact CC BY-SA, FakeNewsNet academic-only) before shipping it in a .nest.

RECALL CLIFFS + CJK/THAI: 1-bit excels at high dim and can fail at low dim - validate recall@10 on the actual PT-BR demo model before defaulting any nano preset, keep int8/RQ the safe default, and never ship a 1-bit preset without bm25 (and the tokenizer fix) as a recall backstop; aggressive vector quantization makes the lexical path more load-bearing.

MTEB HARNESS NEEDS QRELS the PT-BR demo lacks; the recall-vs-exact-f32 overlap metric works with zero labels as the interim, but real nDCG/MRR needs a seeded synthetic or hand-labeled qrels set or the numbers are vacuous - budget for building it before claiming quality non-regression.
quick_wins: Replace hardcoded zstd level-19 (zstd_codec.rs:10) with level/LDM params and bump to level 22 + long-distance-matching for large payloads - one-time build cost, level-independent decode, no format change.

Store chunk_ids as 32 raw SHA-256 bytes instead of the 71-byte 'sha256:<64 hex>' ascii (~2.2x on that section, content_hash invariant, single roundtrip test) - highest size/effort ratio in the project.

Add int8 scale_kind=1 block-scaled int8 (one f16 scale per 32-dim block) reusing the float16 codec: recovers per-vector-outlier recall at ~same size, NO new encoding id and NO version bump because the scale_kind field already exists at int8.rs:18 and parse() already rejects unknown kinds.
1-byte log-quantized BM25 doc_lengths (replace raw u32) - 4x on the doc-length array, absorbed by the exact rerank, bump only BM25_PAYLOAD_VERSION.
Add the per-codec roundtrip+content_hash-equality test template now (mirrors the existing zstd_roundtrip_preserves_bytes test) so every later codec ships behind a hard merge gate.
Enable clap's suggestions feature for Jaro did_you_mean over the 8 subcommand names and real chunk_ids - error-branch only, zero hot-path cost, pure ergonomics.

Add a u32 offset table at the head of chunk_ids/canonical/spans so cite/materialize reach chunk N in O(1) off mmap instead of the current O(n) length-prefixed scan - compression-neutral but unblocks serving large compressed corpora.
Add an F16C tier to the AVX2 f16 dot path (vcvtph2ps) so the compressed/tiny f16 preset stops falling back to scalar on x86 (~25 lines, parity test already exists).

Replace query.extract::<Vec<f32>>() (nest_file.rs:23) with a zero-copy PyBuffer<f32> borrow + Python::detach - removes a per-search heap alloc+memcpy and gives free multi-thread concurrency on the read-only mmap.
Reserve and name encoding ids 4-9 and section ids 0x09-0x10 as constants in layout/mod.rs now (no behavior change) so the additive lanes are claimed and every later PR is a small additive diff.
